notes: Federal rules, plus state levies: Vienna's employer levy and the tourism contributions of the western and southern states.

items.name: Annual Financial Statements Filed with the Company Register (Firmenbuch)
items.rule: Within 9 months after the balance sheet date
items.applies: GmbH, FlexKapG and AG; branches file the foreign company's accounts
items.description: Filed electronically; automatic fines apply to the company and each director for late filing.

items.name: Shareholders' Approval of the Annual Accounts / Annual General Meeting
items.rule: Within the first 8 months of the financial year
items.description: The shareholders adopt the accounts, decide on the profit and discharge the management.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax Return (Körperschaftsteuererklärung)
items.rule: 30 June of the following year when filed electronically (later under a tax adviser's quota)
items.description: Filed through FinanzOnline.

items.name: Corporate Income Tax Prepayments
items.rule: 15 February, 15 May, 15 August and 15 November
items.description: Quarterly prepayments set by the tax office; at least the minimum corporate income tax.

items.name: Income Tax Return (and partnership return)
items.rule: 30 June of the following year when filed electronically
items.applies: Sole proprietors and partners; partnerships file a return determining the profit
items.description: Filed through FinanzOnline.

items.name: Income Tax Prepayments
items.rule: 15 February, 15 May, 15 August and 15 November
items.description: Quarterly prepayments set by the tax office.

items.name: Social Insurance Contributions of the Self-Employed (SVS)
items.rule: End of February, May, August and November
items.applies: Sole proprietors and partners insured with the SVS
items.description: Quarterly contributions for pension, health and accident insurance.

items.name: Annual VAT Return (Umsatzsteuererklärung)
items.rule: 30 June of the following year when filed electronically
items.description: Reconciles the year's advance returns.

items.name: VAT Advance Return (UVA, monthly)
items.rule: 15th of the second following month
items.description: Filed through FinanzOnline with payment.

items.name: VAT Advance Return (UVA, quarterly)
items.rule: 15 May, 15 August, 15 November and 15 February
items.applies: Businesses with prior-year turnover up to €100,000
items.description: Filed through FinanzOnline with payment.

items.name: VAT Registration (leaving the small-business exemption)
items.rule: When annual turnover passes the small-business threshold
items.description: Once the threshold is passed, VAT is charged and advance returns begin.

items.name: Beneficial Owners Register (WiEReG) — Annual Review
items.rule: Review and confirm once a year; report changes within 4 weeks
items.description: Beneficial owners are reported through the Unternehmensserviceportal.

items.name: Wage Tax, Employer Contribution (DB) and Surcharge (DZ)
items.rule: 15th of the following month
items.description: Wage tax withheld and the employer contribution to the family fund are paid to the tax office.

items.name: Social Insurance Contributions and Monthly Contribution Statement (mBGM)
items.rule: 15th of the following month
items.description: Employer and employee contributions are reported and paid to the health insurance fund.

items.name: Municipal Payroll Tax (Kommunalsteuer)
items.rule: 15th of the following month
items.description: 3% of wages, paid to the municipality where the employees work.

items.name: Municipal Payroll Tax — Annual Declaration
items.rule: 31 March (for the previous calendar year)
items.description: Filed through FinanzOnline for every municipality with a place of business.

items.name: Annual Pay Slips (Lohnzettel L16)
items.rule: End of February (for the previous calendar year)
items.description: Transmitted electronically for every employee.

items.name: Transfer Pricing Documentation
items.rule: Provided within 30 days of the tax office's request
items.applies: Companies with cross-border related-party transactions (master file and local file from €50 million turnover)
items.description: Country-by-country notifications are due by the end of the group's financial year.

items.name: Carinthia Tourism Levy (Tourismusabgabe)
items.rule: Annual declaration and payment on the dates in the state's notice
items.applies: Businesses in Carinthia that benefit directly or indirectly from tourism
items.description: The contribution is based on turnover and the business's sector group; the state or tourism association sets the filing date each year.

items.name: Salzburg Tourism Contribution (Tourismusbeitrag)
items.rule: Annual declaration and payment on the dates in the state's notice
items.applies: Businesses in Salzburg that benefit directly or indirectly from tourism
items.description: The contribution is based on turnover and the business's sector group; the state or tourism association sets the filing date each year.

items.name: Styria Tourism Contribution (Tourismusinteressentenbeitrag)
items.rule: Annual declaration and payment on the dates in the state's notice
items.applies: Businesses in Styria that benefit directly or indirectly from tourism
items.description: The contribution is based on turnover and the business's sector group; the state or tourism association sets the filing date each year.

items.name: Tyrol Tourism Contribution (Pflichtbeitrag an den Tourismusverband)
items.rule: Annual declaration and payment on the dates in the state's notice
items.applies: Businesses in Tyrol that benefit directly or indirectly from tourism
items.description: The contribution is based on turnover and the business's sector group; the state or tourism association sets the filing date each year.

items.name: Upper Austria Tourism Contribution (Tourismusbeitrag)
items.rule: Annual declaration and payment on the dates in the state's notice
items.applies: Businesses in Upper Austria that benefit directly or indirectly from tourism
items.description: The contribution is based on turnover and the business's sector group; the state or tourism association sets the filing date each year.

employerItems.name: Vienna Employer Levy (Dienstgeberabgabe, "U-Bahn-Steuer")
employerItems.applies: Employers with employees working in Vienna
employerItems.description: A weekly amount per employee, paid monthly to the City of Vienna.

employerItems.name: Vienna Employer Levy — Annual Declaration
employerItems.applies: Employers with employees working in Vienna
employerItems.description: The annual declaration of the employer levy.
